description: This file defines configuration structures and constants for the Kubernetes proxy server, including platform-specific settings for Linux and Windows, proxy modes, local traffic detection modes, and related configuration options.

classes.name: KubeProxyLinuxConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration options specific to Linux platform for kube-proxy.

classes.name: KubeProxyWindowsConfiguration
classes.description: Configuration options specific to Windows platform for kube-proxy.

classes.name: DetectLocalConfiguration
classes.description: Optional settings for detecting local traffic mode.

classes.name: KubeProxyConfiguration
classes.description: Main configuration structure for kube-proxy, including platform-specific options, modes, and sync periods.

classes.name: ProxyMode
classes.description: Enumeration of proxy modes: iptables, ipvs, nftables, kernelspace.

classes.name: LocalMode
classes.description: Enumeration of local traffic detection modes: ClusterCIDR, NodeCIDR, BridgeInterface, InterfaceNamePrefix.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the value of ProxyMode or LocalMode from a string.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of ProxyMode or LocalMode.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name of ProxyMode or LocalMode.
